title: Weighted spatial averages with missing observations: Convergence and accuracy of delta-method variance approximations
summary: Weighted spatial averages from incomplete networks are ratios whose variance is approximated by truncating a Taylor series (the delta method). Three questions remain open: whether the series converges, how large a truncation's error is, and how it behaves as the network grows. We address these for observations missing completely at random, independently with a common probability $α$.
